gap: No result ChatGPT got states that BLUETTI sells a panel-connection kit for a single Apex 300 (Apex 300 Home Integration Kit, $699, 'Compatible Models: Apex300'), while the only home backup kit BLUETTI lists for the Apex 200 comes in a 2× Apex 200 + 2× B300K + Hub A1 bundle at $5,699, and the Hub A1 manual covers only the Apex 300.
standout_why: Compared against BLUETTI's own Apex 200 vs Apex 300 blog (2026-11-05, cited), the Apex 200 product page (cited) and the Apex 300 product pages (cited). The blog says it 'does not name specific home integration kits or transfer switch models for either unit' and only says panel use 'requires compatible integration or transfer equipment'. The Apex 200 page does not mention any transfer switch, home panel kit or SolarX. The Apex 300 page mentions 'Home Backup Kit' bundles and an AT1 panel but gives no compatibility list. ChatGPT's answer only says 'use compatible transfer equipment'. None of these pages names the kit, says which model it fits, gives its price or says that one Apex 200 has no kit of its own.
decides: For 'home backup' that means wiring into the house panel, the Apex 300 is the only one of the two with a maker-listed single-unit kit: one Apex 300 ($1,499) plus the Home Integration Kit ($699) comes to $2,198 on BLUETTI US today. On BLUETTI's store, the Apex 200 reaches a home backup kit only in a two-unit Hub A1 bundle ($5,699), and the Hub A1 manual (V1.2) and product page list only the Apex 300. That supports the Apex 300 for panel-connected backup. The Apex 200 ($1,099 early-bird, ends Nov 18) suits plug-in essentials over extension cords or its TT-30R. Both take B300K and B500K batteries, so capacity does not decide between them.

findings.label: Home Integration Kit: compatible models and contents
findings.value: 'Compatible Models: Apex300'. Single-unit kit $699.00 (was $799): Reliance sub panel with 50 A SS2-50 inlet box, 50 A outlet box (Reliance), NEMA 14-50 to SS2-50R cable, 50 A fast-charging cable for Apex 300 (single-unit use). Parallel-setup kit $799.00 with a parallel charging cable instead.
findings.source_title: Apex 300 Home Integration Kit - BLUETTI US
findings.note: Price and availability also checked with storecheck search on bluettipower.com (available: true, $699, compare-at $799). The page does not give a circuit count. User guide linked: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0536/3390/8911/files/Sub_Panel_With_Transfer_Switch.pdf

findings.label: Home backup kit availability
findings.value: No single-unit Apex 200 home integration kit is listed. The only Apex 200 home backup listing is '2 × Apex 200 + 2 × B300K + Hub A1 + Home Backup Kit', $5,699 (was $6,299).
findings.source_title: 2 × Apex 200 + 2 × B300K + Hub A1 + Home Backup Kit - BLUETTI US
findings.note: Found with storecheck search 'home integration kit apex' on bluettipower.com. The results were the Apex 300, AC500, EP500PRO and AC300 kits plus this Apex 200 bundle. Storecheck returned no product description text, and WebFetch of the URL showed the base Apex 200 page, so the kit's contents and voltage are not stated.

findings.label: Accessories named on the maker page
findings.value: B300K and B500K expansion batteries (up to six per unit), Hub A1 (required to link several Apex 200s; three units with 18× B500K reach 99.84 kWh and 6,000 W), Charger 2, and a 30 A TT-30 AC charging cable (bundle only). The page does not mention a transfer switch, home panel kit, generator inlet or SolarX 4K.
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Apex 200 Expandable Power Station | 2560Wh 3200W - BLUETTI US
findings.note: Quote: 'Each Apex 200 supports up to six compatible expansion batteries.' Price: $1,099.00 (Super Early Bird, ends Nov 18; was $1,399). Shipping: 'expected to ship in late January for orders placed on or after Nov. 14.'

findings.label: Hub A1 parallel box compatibility
findings.value: 'Connects up to 3 Apex 300 units for a massive 11.5kW output'; 30 A / 50 A outputs. Apex 200 not listed. $699 (with 2 cables) / $749 (with 3 cables), shown out of stock.
findings.note: Variant prices and available:false checked with storecheck product. The page's spec table describes the B300 battery, not the Hub A1, so it was not used.

findings.label: Hub A1 manual: supported units and outlets
findings.value: Manual V1.2 covers only the Apex 300: connect 1–3 Apex 300 units with P050A parallel cables. Outlets: 30 A NEMA L14-30R and 50 A NEMA 14-50R. Grid input from a NEMA TT-30 or 14-50P outlet. Apex 200 not mentioned.
findings.source_title: BLUETTI HUB A1 USER MANUAL (ManualsLib mirror, V1.2)
findings.note: The maker's PDF (https://s4.bluettipower.com/bluetti_lgf/support/2026/02/40edaf24-4679-452a-8cc6-f66841660f76.pdf, linked from support.bluettipower.com/en-us/products/hub-a1-parallel-box) was over the 10 MB fetch limit, so the text was read on the ManualsLib copy. This conflicts with BLUETTI's store selling 2× Apex 200 + Hub A1 bundles. The manual may predate Apex 200 support.

findings.label: Hub D1 (DC outputs) compatibility
findings.value: 'Hub D1 Power Hub for Apex 300', 700 W total DC, 12 V/50 A Anderson port, $299. The Apex 300 page says 'Hub D1 is required for DC power'.
findings.source_title: Hub D1 Power Hub for Apex 300 - BLUETTI US
findings.note: Read with storecheck search 'hub a1' (listing text and price). The Apex 200 has built-in USB and a 12 V/30 A Anderson port per BLUETTI's 2026-11-05 comparison blog, so it needs no hub for DC.

findings.label: SolarX 4K requirement and price/shipping
findings.value: Up to 4,000 W solar input '*Requires a SolarX 4K'. Base unit $1,499.00 (was $1,699). 'Expected to ship in late January.'
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Apex 300 Home Battery Backup | 2,764.8Wh, 3,840W - BLUETTI US
findings.note: The product page also says 'When connected to the AT1 panel' for essential-circuit backup and lists 'Home Backup Kit' bundles with B300K/B500K. Our page's 'Ships from Nov 20' status is now out of date.

findings.label: AC charging input by cable (named reviewer)
findings.value: 1,800 W on the included cable via the 15 A input; 3,200 W Turbo with an optional TT-30P or NEMA 14-50P cable on the P050A port
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Apex 200 Review: Specs, Price and Apex 300 Comparison (2026) - Dan Miller, Backup Power Hub
findings.note: Dan Miller attributes these figures to BLUETTI's Apex 200 user manual. He also says the manual lists B300 Pro, B300K, B500 Pro and B500K as compatible and 'advises against mixing battery models'. The maker manual PDF was too large to open, so this rests on Miller's reading.

findings.label: 240V / transfer-switch suitability (named reviewer)
findings.value: The Solar Lab: 'the Apex 200 doesn't offer the same 240V split-phase capabilities that the Apex 300 offers'. A whole-home system that needs split-phase power for a transfer switch connection may require the Apex 300.
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Apex 200 Review: A Powerful and Smart Expandable Power Station - The Solar Lab
findings.note: The review also gives 1,800 W AC charging, 'up to 3,200W with the BLUETTI Fast Charger'. No author or date was shown on the page.

unsourced: Apex 200 user manual text (maker PDF https://s4.bluettipower.com/bluetti_lgf/cms/2026/11/5f5a4b06-226d-4493-8bb9-8fce43730a84.pdf, linked from support.bluettipower.com/en-us/products/apex-200): over the 10 MB fetch limit and the download needed approval, so its compatible-battery list, 'no mixing' warning, charging-port limits and the Apex 200/Hub A1 voltage are not confirmed from the maker document.

Apex 300 user manual V3.1 (https://s4.bluettipower.com/bluetti/purchasePageBiz/2025/12/Apex%20300%20User%20%20Manual%20US%20EN-FR-1764555919287-cde9.pdf): over the fetch limit. Looked for the per-unit B300K/B500K maximum, single-unit 240 V output watts and the Apex 200 cross-compatibility statement.

Whether an Apex 200 and an Apex 300 can be linked: The Solar Lab says the Apex 200 can act as an expansion battery for the Apex 300 (inverters don't combine), while Dan Miller (Backup Power Hub) says the Apex 200 manual shows an Apex 300 on the Apex 200's expansion port. No maker page I opened states either direction.
Contents and output voltage of the 'Home Backup Kit' in the 2× Apex 200 + Hub A1 bundle, and whether two Apex 200s on Hub A1 give 120/240 V split-phase. The listing returned no description text.
Number of circuits in the Apex 300 Home Integration Kit sub panel. Not on the product page; the linked Sub_Panel_With_Transfer_Switch.pdf was not opened.
